There has been physical conflict, or you have noticed situations where it is becoming likely.

Your child wants to stay beside you, follows you, or asks you to do something together.
Your toddler wants to speak while you are in a conversation.
Your child looks to you after doing something, or you want to acknowledge their effort.
You may be considering what fills waiting time or sits in the background at home.
Your household or caregivers may use more than one language.
